title: USA Anime Club: initial primary-source evidence inventory
purpose: Document narrow, externally verifiable support for representative claims. This is NOT independent manual verification of entire guides or proof of testing or attendance.
caution: AI-assisted research and online source access can be wrong. A source hyperlink is not evidence that every adjacent statement follows from the source. Confirm exact claim text, source sections, changes since access, original reporting and image rights before final approval.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Seasonal release lineups are published by distributors and must be checked for the exact season and region.
guides.limitations: Distributor announcement; this is not a claim of current availability for any title.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: US consumer advice recommends checking the entire product listing, shipping terms, refund terms and payment protections.
guides.limitations: FTC guidance; does not verify any anime merchandise seller.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Discord provides spoiler-tag instructions, but automated access returned 403; manual confirmation needed.
guides.limitations: Site conventions are voluntary community rules, not legal requirements.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: US public-accommodation accessibility principles apply to covered public venues and services.
guides.limitations: General Title III public-accommodations framework, not a finding about any particular convention venue, ticket policy, or physical accessibility.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: US entertainment availability discovery should be verified on the provider's own title page and specific plan.
guides.limitations: JustWatch is an aggregator; not primary proof for any episode or plan.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: US copyright grants owners exclusive public-performance rights in audiovisual works, subject to limitations.
guides.limitations: Whether a particular event requires permission is situation-specific; obtain legal advice where needed.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Covered public accommodations have accessibility obligations, and the specifics depend on venue circumstances.
guides.limitations: Not an inspection of any cosplay gear, tools, props or convention.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Publication format and substantive edition changes may require separate ISBN identification.
guides.limitations: International ISBN Agency source describes separate formats and editions. No individual product has been physically inspected; the VIZ publisher comparison is separately linked in the article.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Public performance rights in audiovisual works are part of US copyright law.
guides.limitations: The proposed four-week club plan was not conducted as a real event.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Accessible captions include relevant speech and sound information, which dialogue translations may not.
guides.limitations: Specific services' tracks and players need device-level checking.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: TV rating information is one tool for comparing age/content suitability.
guides.limitations: Ratings and actual title availability require title-specific checks.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Changing an existing copyrighted work or providing credit alone does not automatically supply permission; fair use is case-specific.
guides.limitations: No individualized legal determination or creator permissions have been obtained by this site.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: WorldCat can be used to discover potential holdings, not to guarantee a local library owns a particular volume today.
guides.limitations: Must confirm title, ISBN, format and borrowing rules with the actual local system.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Different substantive editions or formats may have separate ISBNs; a set can have its own ISBN.
guides.limitations: International ISBN Agency source describes separate formats and editions. No individual product has been physically inspected; the VIZ publisher comparison is separately linked in the article.

guides.verification_scope: one representative research claim; not a full article review
guides.claim: Captions include meaningful sound and dialogue information needed for accessible audiovisual media.
guides.limitations: No device-specific accessibility testing has been performed.
